title: Her mother retrieves her from the home talent show
summary: On a home-talent show in Washington, Pennsylvania, her mother found out where she was and picked her up. She says her playing was already known to musicians as far as New York.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: About your touring after that summer with Buzzin' Fredeson Harris. The home talent show - you were going to tell me about the home talent show.
Well, in Washington, Pennsylvania - I went there and she didn't know where I was so she found out where I was through a friend.
Yes, my mother, so she came there and picked me up. I was kind of glad because the owner of the show - they had these young kids, 12 and 14, 15 years old, and this

man was not too good. One person I appreciate very much and she was a very good friend, she was 18. She watched over these kids. This man had taken 3 of us into a room and I never had a drink in my life except once when I was a little baby.
How did you get in contact with this man?

He knew about me. By this time everybody knew about me, even musicians from New York. I was playing a style of piano that must have been amazing to them but it was nothing to me. You know, I never had a needle or anything, I was just playing, that's all, but it reached musicians in New York and everywhere knew about my playing.
